g.text: Separate operating policies change the penalty conclusion
Same 64 exposed images, 305 projected car references and fixed retained detector outputs.
Each detector gets its own retrospective minimum. No deployment threshold or calibrated score policy is selected.
New is lower only for 0 < miss/FP penalty < 1/16. The endpoints are ties; old is lower above 1/16.
All 519 original threshold cells, 51 exact penalty cells and optimizer ties are retained. These are overlapping descriptions.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48535f

g.text: Conditional on the supplied projection. Earlier reference ambiguity, conventional query parity and unproven savings remain.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #48535f

g.text: No new inference, reserved outcomes, policy training or held-out gain. High miss counts are not an operating recommendation.
